mapper.sql: FROM product g JOIN category c ON g.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN category p ON c.parent_id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN category gp ON p.parent_id=gp.category_id
g.sell_status=1 AND c.is_deleted=0 AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR p.is_deleted=0) AND (p.parent_id IS NULL OR gp.is_deleted=0)

sql.if: AND (g.product_name LIKE #{q.pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR g.summary LIKE #{q.pattern} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT c.category_id,c.parent_id,c.category_name,c.category_level FROM category c LEFT JOIN category p ON c.parent_id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN category gp ON p.parent_id=gp.category_id WHERE c.is_deleted=0 AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR p.is_deleted=0) AND (p.parent_id IS NULL OR gp.is_deleted=0) ORDER BY c.sort_order DESC,c.category_id
SELECT carousel_id,image_url,redirect_url FROM carousel WHERE is_enabled=1 ORDER BY sort_order DESC,carousel_id LIMIT 5
SELECT g.* JOIN home_product_config h ON h.product_id=g.product_id WHERE AND h.is_enabled=1 AND h.config_type=#{type} ORDER BY h.sort_order DESC,h.config_id LIMIT 8
SELECT g.* WHERE ORDER BY g.selling_price ASC,g.product_idg.selling_price DESC,g.product_idg.created_at DESC,g.product_id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
